description.after:
Advance voting for the November 3 general election runs October 13–30, inclusive. This calendar span does not mean polling locations are open continuously. Confirm daily hours, weekend availability, and locations with your county election office or Georgia My Voter Page.

Official state source checked October 25, 2026.

description.after:
Advance voting before the December 1 runoff, if needed. The Secretary of State says voting begins as soon as possible, but no later than November 23, and ends November 25.
